reason: A Windows desktop companion plugin that continuously monitors CPU, memory, GPU, and NVMe temperatures and presents hardware information in a floating panel.

summaries.zh: 这是一款适用于 Windows 的桌面温度监控插件，可实时显示 CPU、内存、GPU 和 NVMe 温度及基本硬件信息。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop monitoring plugin that displays real-time CPU, memory, GPU, and NVMe temperatures along with basic hardware information.

capabilities: Reads CPU, memory, GPU, and NVMe temperature sensors
Displays a floating Windows desktop monitoring panel
Reads hardware and system information through WMI and Windows APIs
Requests administrator privileges for some sensor readings
Spawns and manages a PowerShell desktop process
Writes runtime data, status, position, and log files under the user temporary directory
Can register automatic startup through Windows Task Scheduler
